unmapped_findings: The Fe-30Mn-1.2C-4Al alloy is an intermediate Al variant: its mechanical data fall between those of the Al-free Fe-30Mn-1.2C alloy (weakening/embrittlement on aging) and the Fe-30Mn-1.2C-8Al alloy (strengthening on aging) [b0024].

Alloys with 4 wt.% and 6 wt.% Al are only very weakly affected by the applied aging treatments (450/500/550/600 °C for 1 h and 24 h) in terms of their mechanical data, compared with Fe-30Mn-1.2C and Fe-30Mn-1.2C-8Al [b0024].

The intermediate alloy variants with 2–6 wt.% Al do not show equivalent mechanical properties to the ~8 wt.% Al variant, and a much smaller influence of aging on the tensile behavior is observed in the 2–6 wt.% Al cases [b0025].
